identities:
SELECT id,uuid,name,parent_comedian_id,visible,instagram_account,instagram_followers,
 instagram_followers_refreshed_at,popularity,website,home_city,home_state,has_image,block_reason,block_added_at
 FROM comedians WHERE id IN (712,735,746,908,14618,54369,162399,165737,166992,171846,180157,207621,223894,226475,235139,312265,440843,444574,535810,549605,1068549,1488180) ORDER BY id
dependencies:
SELECT c.id,c.name,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM lineup_items l WHERE l.comedian_id=c.uuid) AS lineups,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM lineup_items l JOIN shows s ON s.id=l.show_id WHERE l.comedian_id=c.uuid AND s.date>now()) AS upcoming,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM favorite_comedians f WHERE f.comedian_id=c.uuid) AS favorites,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM comedians ch WHERE ch.parent_comedian_id=c.id) AS children,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM comedian_podcasts p WHERE p.comedian_id=c.id) AS podcasts,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM episode_appearances a WHERE a.comedian_id=c.id) AS appearances
 FROM comedians c WHERE c.id IN (712,735,746,908,14618,54369,162399,165737,166992,171846,180157,207621,223894,226475,235139,312265,440843,444574,535810,549605,1068549,1488180) ORDER BY c.id
lineup_provenance:
SELECT c.id,c.name,s.id AS show_id,s.name AS show_name,s.date,cl.name AS venue,s.show_page_url
 FROM comedians c JOIN lineup_items l ON l.comedian_id=c.uuid JOIN shows s ON s.id=l.show_id JOIN clubs cl ON cl.id=s.club_id
 WHERE c.id IN (712,735,746,908,14618,54369,162399,165737,166992,171846,180157,207621,223894,226475,235139,312265,440843,444574,535810,549605,1068549,1488180) ORDER BY c.id,s.date
hidden_parent_visible_children:
SELECT c.id,c.name,c.parent_comedian_id,p.name AS parent FROM comedians c
 JOIN comedians p ON p.id=c.parent_comedian_id WHERE c.visible AND NOT p.visible ORDER BY c.id
unlinked_handles:
SELECT lower(trim(instagram_account)) AS handle,array_agg(id ORDER BY id) AS ids,array_agg(name ORDER BY id) AS names
 FROM comedians WHERE visible AND parent_comedian_id IS NULL AND NULLIF(trim(instagram_account),'') IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY lower(trim(instagram_account)) HAVING count(*)>1 ORDER BY handle
julie_observations:
SELECT id,comedian_id,platform,follower_count,observed_at,created_at
 FROM comedian_follower_observations WHERE comedian_id=746 ORDER BY id
image_assets:
SELECT comedian_id,source_image_url,original_path,is_active FROM comedian_image_assets
 WHERE comedian_id IN (746,54369,735,165737,162399,180157)
